dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Fah, you've been on your phone all day. Don't you think it's too much?
dialogue.reading: ˈfɑː, juːv bɪn ɑːn jʊr ˈfoʊn ˈɔːl ˈdeɪ. ˈdoʊnt juː ˈθɪŋk ɪts ˈtuː ˈmʌtʃ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No. I'm not addicted, if that's what you mean.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. aɪm ˈnɑːt əˈdɪktɪd, ɪf ðæts ˈwʌt juː ˈmiːn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? Haven't you checked your screen time this week?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ˈhævənt juː ˈtʃɛkt jʊr ˈskriːn ˌtaɪm ðɪs ˈwiːk?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK, it says eight hours a day. But that includes music!
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ, ɪt ˈsɛz ˈeɪt ˈaʊərz ə ˈdeɪ. bʌt ˈðæt ɪnˈkluːdz ˈmjuːzɪk!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Eight hours! And aren't you worried about your privacy? You post photos of our house.
dialogue.reading: ˈeɪt ˈaʊərz! ənd ˈɑːrənt juː ˈwɜːrid əˈbaʊt jʊr ˈpraɪvəsi? juː ˈpoʊst ˈfoʊtoʊz əv aʊr ˈhaʊs.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Only my friends can see them. My account is private.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊnli maɪ ˈfrɛndz kən ˈsiː ðɛm. maɪ əˈkaʊnt ɪz ˈpraɪvət.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: But what about anonymous accounts? Didn't one of them bully your classmate last year?
dialogue.reading: bʌt ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt əˈnɑːnəməs əˈkaʊnts? ˈdɪdənt ˈwʌn əv ðɛm ˈbʊli jʊr ˈklæsmeɪt ˈlæst ˈjɪr?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes. She cried for days, and nobody knew who it was.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ʃiː ˈkraɪd fər ˈdeɪz, ənd ˈnoʊbɑːdi ˈnuː huː ɪt ˈwʌz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's why I worry about you. Can't you put your phone away for one evening?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈwaɪ aɪ ˈwɜːri əˈbaʊt ˈjuː. ˈkænt juː ˈpʊt jʊr ˈfoʊn əˈweɪ fər ˈwʌn ˈiːvnɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Fine. One evening. Shall we watch a movie together, then?
dialogue.reading: ˈfaɪn. ˈwʌn ˈiːvnɪŋ. ʃæl wiː ˈwɑːtʃ ə ˈmuːvi təˈɡɛðər, ˈðɛn?
